evidence.static_summary: r34: pinned toolchain build; 23 Rust host tests (the Purple-lib text in all seven languages, the symbol reader on this build's own NRO against nm) plus the mod's ARM and native suites; verify: 22 hook windows, frame colour setter, NZCVQ/GE audit, exports, payload inventory.

limitations: r34 has not run in game; it needs Purple-lib r15 or later for its Mod Options page and help
A highlighted frame stays white after its item is taken, by the user's choice
r26 ran on Eden master-07677aa500-master with a player report for luck highlights; loading beside a foreign hook on the same entry has not been exercised and rests on Forge's hook.c and host fixtures
Gameplay evidence for r25 is one unitemized user report on Eden (2026-11-02). Ryujinx and native Switch coverage remain unconfirmed.
Individual player-page quantity, Palico exclusion, appraisal/collection, persistence and consecutive-quest checks were not separately reported.
Log contains HLE/keyboard and Maxwell assertions plus an unmapped-memory error; no clean-run or clean-shutdown claim. These emulator messages are not attributed to the plugin.
Native inventory capacity and the 150-entry appraisal queue remain; unsupported records or quantity products above 32767 suppress the entire multiplier attempt.
Ryujinx and physical Switch gameplay are untested.
Successful cache calls do not establish CPU translation freshness; the second forced check broader role remains incompletely traced.
reason: r34: r33 with its Purple-lib help topic moved from the Village/Hub help to the Mod Options page's own help, opened with the game's help button on that page; needs Purple-lib r15 or later.
